description: Project module for styio-community decision coordination, local server-side workflow APIs, forum records, web UI, and delivery governance.
technology_stack: Python 3 local HTTP server and community coordination library
JSON file-backed decision record and forum persistence
Static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript web UI
Node.js Stitch design helper scripts under tools/stitch
GitHub Actions workflow automation for ci-gate and styio-audit
internal_components: Community decision state machine for detected, approved, dispatched, completed, blocked, and rejected records
JsonRecordStore and ForumStore local persistence adapters
Repository request adapters for styio and styio-view handoff records
Local HTTP API and static web interface
Repository-local CI gate and external styio-audit workflow
open_source_components: Python standard library http.server, json, pathlib, tempfile, threading, unittest, and urllib
Browser standard APIs for fetch, DOM rendering, and static assets
Node.js npm tooling for design helpers
security_boundaries: Authentication, authorization, and identity implementation is not currently exposed by the local server; any future auth code may be public only when it uses documented standard protocol behavior.
Privacy and PII or personal data payloads must not be committed in decision records, forum records, examples, fixtures, or logs.
Password storage is not a styio-community responsibility; production passwords must not be stored in JSON records, forum records, code, examples, or tests.
Secret, token, key, and credential material, including Stitch API keys and deployment credentials, must stay private.
Production private material is offline or not committed to GitHub; generated .env files, private keys, tokens, and credential bundles must stay outside the repository.
Permission matrix and route authorization behavior for decision, forum, approval, rejection, dispatch, reaction, and demo routes must be explicit before hosted service deployment.
Deployment security config must cover TLS, CORS, CSRF, cookie, debug exposure, and hosted server deployment boundaries before cloud publication.
SBOM, CVE, and dependency vulnerability scan evidence is required for @google/stitch-sdk and any future npm or Python dependency before release gates pass.
DAST black-box penetration security regression must cover hosted or externally reachable community server deployment surfaces before public deployment.
Runtime secret manager or KMS key rotation owns production tokens, Stitch keys, deployment credentials, and hosted server secrets.
Rate limit, anti replay nonce, replay protection, and idempotency boundaries must be documented for externally reachable POST routes before hosted deployment.
Log redaction and audit log rules must prevent request tokens, PII, API keys, credentials, and decision-private data from being written to logs.
SSRF egress allowlist, URL allowlist, and outbound request boundaries must be documented before adapters perform network calls.
Command execution must use subprocess allowlist boundaries and reject shell injection surfaces in scripts and future server helpers.

resource_classes.description: Owns coordination record contracts, lifecycle transitions, local JSON storage, and adapter-facing handoff requests.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Decision records must copy only the minimal coordination payload needed for downstream action; repository source and private issue data must stay outside stored records.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Record persistence uses atomic file replacement; future multi-user hosted service deployment must add explicit write serialization.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing kind, payload, actor, decision, dispatch target, and adapter outputs must fail closed with structured validation errors.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Demo records, rejected records, blocked records, and generated local state must stay out of tracked source unless intentionally documented.

state_machine.source: community/state_machine.py, JsonRecordStore, adapters, workflow docs, and unit tests.

transitions.on: record is opened for human decision

resource_classes.description: Owns local forum records, comments, reactions, HTTP routes, and static web UI used to review community decisions.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Forum posts, comments, and reactions must remain compact community metadata and must not copy private source, secrets, or credential material.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: Forum storage uses single-file atomic writes; hosted service deployment requires explicit route authorization and serialized write behavior.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing post, category, author, comment, reaction, route, and request-body values must produce explicit client errors.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: Local forum data and generated community state must remain ignored unless promoted as intentional fixtures.

state_machine.source: ForumStore, community/server.py routes, web UI handlers, and forum tests.
invalid_operations: publishing hosted routes without security boundaries

resource_classes.description: Owns repository-local CI, external styio-audit workflow, Apache-2.0 license evidence, dependency usage boundaries, security boundaries, and Stitch helper dependency governance.
resource_classes.copying_policy: Generated Stitch artifacts, API keys, credentials, and dependency caches must remain untracked and outside source-distribution evidence.
resource_classes.concurrency_policy: CI and audit gates must remain separate required checks; workflow template changes must be synchronized from released styio-audit policy.
resource_classes.nullability_policy: Missing license, dependency usage-boundary evidence, local audit workflow, CI workflow, or dependency manifest evidence must fail delivery.
resource_classes.cleanup_policy: node_modules, .stitch output, local caches, generated credentials, and temporary reports must stay ignored or be removed before delivery.

state_machine.source: GitHub Actions workflows, package manifests, license policy files, dependency usage evidence, and security boundary docs.

transitions.on: dependency manifest is present and npm install resolves
repository-local tests and CI workflow pass
protected branch pull request gates pass
license, dependency, workflow, or security evidence is missing

invalid_operations: adding dependencies without commercial authorization boundary evidence
